summary: Verified the journal layer end-to-end (real query returns 12 excerpts in ~380ms under 10KB, 186 tests green, prettier clean) and then committed only the journal-related changes—journal tools, chunking, exposure tests, session factory/repository wiring, and dependency updates—on pi-web as 'Add memory journal with journal_search tool and segment chunking' (24 files, +2795/-17), leaving another active session's skill files in packages/memory-extension/ unstaged.
decisions: Chunking cuts spans at user-message boundaries at ~40 KB; a single turn exceeding the budget is cut in front of assistant messages so a tool call and its result stay together, and oversized assistant prose is kept whole rather than truncated.
JournalStore.append returns one meta per chunk (all indexed) so the last chunk's entry id is the resume point.
A before_agent_start hook appends one tool-availability line to the system prompt only when it does not already mention the tools, covering the prompt-override path that discards Pi's tool list.
Backfill CLI defaults the workspace to pnpm's INIT_CWD so running it from the repo root targets the repo.
Commit scoped to the assistant's own files only; another active Claude Code session's changes (gizmo.extensions.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, packages/memory-extension/) were left unstaged and uncommitted.
errors: Backfill reruns pick up new messages from another active Claude Code session in the same repo—initially suspected as duplication, confirmed as correct behaviour for in-progress sessions.

Pre-existing check:loc (line-count) failures unrelated to this work exist in packages/memory-extension/skills/backfill-agent-journal/scripts/backfill-journal.mjs (473 lines, from the other session) and seven other files; this segment's own files are all under 250 lines.
pnpm check:loc is not defined at the package level; must be run from repo root (pnpm check at root works).
